target_pdb.description: Path to the target structure (.pdb) the binder is designed against.

target_chain.description: Chain id(s) on the target to design against (BindCraft accepts a comma-separated list).

target_hotspots.description: Residue indices on the target chain that the binder should contact. Empty means no hotspot guidance.

binder_length.description: Fixed binder length (BindCraft also supports a [min,max] range; we pin both bounds equal here for determinism).

num_designs.description: Target ``number_of_final_designs`` written into the generated settings JSON.

num_recycles.description: AF2 recycles during the design trajectory (``num_recycles_design`` in BindCraft's advanced settings).

max_trajectories.description: Optional upper bound on attempted BindCraft trajectories. Null leaves upstream behavior unbounded until requested designs are accepted.

filter_mode.description: Filter cascade to use. `default` preserves upstream BindCraft thresholds; `permissive` disables thresholds for bounded smoke validation.
